question: Should RFC 0015 be accepted with display-independent durable archival of provider reasoning and commentary as the normative cross-provider and cross-channel contract?
rationale: Landed implementation slices demonstrate feasibility, but they do not independently authorize a permanent privacy, retention, and trust-boundary policy for every provider and channel.

options.title: Ratify and accept
options.body: Approve the archival boundary and document ownership, then mark the RFC accepted and link its canonical implementation or completion issue before merge.

options.title: Make archival policy-controlled
options.body: Amend the contract so sensitive reasoning and commentary persistence is explicitly configurable or capability-scoped before acceptance.

options.title: Keep behavior implementation-specific
options.body: Retain the landed channel and provider behavior without merging a universal normative RFC yet.

recommendation.title: Ratify and accept
recommendation.body: Approve the archival boundary and document ownership, then mark the RFC accepted and link its canonical implementation or completion issue before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: They are the strongest available current-main routing candidate because they merged and maintained shared progress-lane behavior central to the proposed contract.
